# **1. Introduction**

This document turns the requirements and the architecture of CampusNotes into three build-ready designs: the database (entity-relationship diagram with indexing definitions), the API contract between the Next.js client and the Node.js server, and wireframes for the six primary screens.

**Alignment with the approved ERD.** The data model keeps all 10 entities of the project ERD (User, Admin, Student, Course, Module, AI Summary, Progress, Quiz, MCQ, Quiz Result) and all of its relationships. Two junction tables are added because the ERD contains two many-to-many relationships: `enrollments` (Student enrolls in Course, M:N) and `progress_modules` (Module tracks Progress, N:M). The result is 12 tables.

**How zero-login and a database fit together.** Students never register or log in (FR-04, NFR-06). On the first visit the server creates an anonymous student: a `users` row with role `STUDENT` and no name, e-mail or password, plus a `students` row that holds a random device token. The token is kept in an HttpOnly cookie. Progress and quiz results are saved against this anonymous student, so no personal data is stored. Only administrators have e-mail and password. This follows SRS requirement FR-12, which asks for progress records and results to be stored in the database.

> Note for consistency with Week 3: the Week 3 DFD showed Progress (D5) and Quiz Results (D6) in browser local storage. In this model they are database tables, and the browser keeps only the anonymous device token and the answers of a quiz that is still in progress. The Week 3 document should be updated to match.

# **2. Database Modeling**

Database: PostgreSQL (managed, as chosen in Week 3). All primary keys are UUIDs. All timestamps are `timestamptz` in UTC.

## **2.1 Entity-Relationship Diagram**

![Figure 1: Entity-Relationship Diagram (ERD)][img1]

*Figure 1: Entity-Relationship Diagram (ERD) of CampusNotes.*

## **2.2 Relationships**

| From (one side) | To                  | Cardinality | How it is implemented                                                          |
|-----------------|---------------------|-------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| users           | admins              | 1:1         | `admins.user_id` is both primary key and foreign key to `users.id`             |
| users           | students            | 1:1         | `students.user_id` is both primary key and foreign key to `users.id`          |
| admins          | courses             | 1:N         | `courses.created_by` references `admins.user_id`                               |
| students        | courses             | M:N         | junction table `enrollments (student_id, course_id)`                           |
| courses         | modules             | 1:N         | `modules.course_id`; `module_count` on `courses` holds the number of modules   |
| modules         | ai_summaries        | 1:N         | `ai_summaries.module_id`; one summary per module content version               |
| modules         | quizzes             | 1:1         | `quizzes.module_id` is UNIQUE                                                  |
| quizzes         | mcqs                | 1:N         | `mcqs.quiz_id`; a quiz serves `mcq_count` questions (default 20)               |
| students        | progress            | 1:1         | `progress.student_id` is UNIQUE                                                |
| progress        | modules             | N:M         | junction table `progress_modules (progress_id, module_id)` for completed modules |
| progress        | modules             | N:1         | `progress.last_visited_module_id` (optional)                                   |
| students        | quiz_results        | 1:N         | `quiz_results.student_id`                                                      |
| quizzes         | quiz_results        | 1:N         | `quiz_results.quiz_id`                                                         |

## **2.3 Integrity Rules**

| Rule                                                   | Enforced by                                                                 | Requirement |
|--------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------|
| Admin must have e-mail and password hash; students need none | CHECK constraint on `users`                                           | NFR-06, NFR-08 |
| E-mail unique (case-insensitive) when present           | Partial unique index on `lower(email)`                                      | NFR-08      |
| A quiz belongs to exactly one module                    | UNIQUE `quizzes.module_id`                                                  | UC-12       |
| Every MCQ belongs to exactly one quiz (no cross-subject mixing) | NOT NULL foreign key `mcqs.quiz_id`; quiz is loaded by `quiz_id` only | NFR-10      |
| Every MCQ has exactly 4 options and one correct option (0 to 3) | CHECK on `options` and `correct_option`                            | FR-06, UC-12 |
| An AI summary has exactly 4 takeaways                   | CHECK `jsonb_array_length(key_takeaways) = 4`                               | FR-05       |
| Module order is unique inside a course                  | UNIQUE (`course_id`, `position`), deferrable so modules can be re-ordered   | UC-11       |
| Score is between 0 and 100 and correct <= total         | CHECK constraints on `quiz_results`                                         | FR-09       |
| Deleting a course removes its modules, quizzes, MCQs, summaries and progress links | `ON DELETE CASCADE`                         | UC-10       |

## **2.4 Indexing Definitions**

Primary keys and UNIQUE constraints create their own indexes automatically. The table lists every index that is defined, the query it serves and the requirement it protects.

| Index                              | Table            | Columns / expression                   | Type              | Query it supports                                              | Requirement |
|------------------------------------|------------------|----------------------------------------|-------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------|-------------|
| `uq_users_email`                   | users            | `lower(email)` WHERE email IS NOT NULL | B-tree, unique, partial | Admin login by e-mail                                     | NFR-08      |
| `uq_students_registration_no`      | students         | `registration_no` WHERE NOT NULL       | B-tree, unique, partial | Optional lookup by registration number                    | UC-06       |
| `students_device_token_key`        | students         | `device_token`                         | B-tree, unique (from constraint) | Find the anonymous student from the cookie on every request | FR-10 |
| `courses_code_key`                 | courses          | `code`                                 | B-tree, unique (from constraint) | Search by exact subject code ("CS-301")                  | NFR-02      |
| `idx_courses_category`             | courses          | `category`                             | B-tree            | Category filter tabs on the home page                          | FR-02       |
| `idx_courses_title_trgm`           | courses          | `title gin_trgm_ops`                   | GIN (pg_trgm)     | Partial-text search `title ILIKE '%struct%'`                   | FR-02, NFR-02 |
| `idx_courses_code_trgm`            | courses          | `code gin_trgm_ops`                    | GIN (pg_trgm)     | Partial subject-code search (`'cs-3'`)                         | FR-02       |
| `idx_courses_created_by`           | courses          | `created_by`                           | B-tree            | Admin: courses managed by an admin; FK maintenance             | UC-10       |
| `uq_modules_course_position`       | modules          | `course_id, position`                  | B-tree, unique    | Module index of a course in order; previous / next module      | FR-03       |
| `idx_enrollments_course`           | enrollments      | `course_id`                            | B-tree            | Courses of a student use the primary key; this one serves the reverse lookup (students of a course) | FR-10 |
| `uq_ai_summaries_module_hash`      | ai_summaries     | `module_id, content_hash`              | B-tree, unique    | Cache lookup: reuse the summary if the module text is unchanged | NFR-03     |
| `progress_student_id_key`          | progress         | `student_id`                           | B-tree, unique (from constraint) | Load the progress record of the current student | FR-10 |
| `idx_progress_last_module`         | progress         | `last_visited_module_id`               | B-tree            | FK maintenance when a module is deleted                        | UC-11       |
| `idx_progress_modules_module`      | progress_modules | `module_id`                            | B-tree            | Reverse lookup and FK maintenance when a module is deleted     | UC-11       |
| `quizzes_module_id_key`            | quizzes          | `module_id`                            | B-tree, unique (from constraint) | Find the quiz of a module                      | UC-08       |
| `idx_quizzes_subject`              | quizzes          | `subject`                              | B-tree            | Admin filter by subject                                        | UC-12       |
| `idx_mcqs_quiz`                    | mcqs             | `quiz_id`                              | B-tree            | Load all MCQs of one quiz in a single indexed read (quiz isolation) | FR-06, NFR-10 |
| `idx_results_student_quiz_date`     | quiz_results     | `student_id, quiz_id, attempt_date DESC` | B-tree          | Attempt history of a student, latest first; best score per quiz | FR-09      |
| `idx_results_quiz`                 | quiz_results     | `quiz_id`                              | B-tree            | FK maintenance; per-quiz statistics                            | UC-09       |

**Indexes deliberately not created.** No index on `modules.content` (large text, never searched), none on `mcqs.options` (read as a whole with its row), and none on `users.role` (the table is small and the column has two values).

**Why the access patterns are fast.** The two heaviest reads are the course catalog and the quiz load. The catalog is a small table that is also cached at the CDN, and category and text filters use the indexes above. A quiz load is one read of `mcqs` through `idx_mcqs_quiz`, so it returns only the questions of that quiz, which also guarantees 0% cross-subject questions.

# **3. REST API Endpoint Contracts**

## **3.1 Why REST**

REST was chosen over GraphQL because the data is made of a few simple resources (courses, modules, quizzes), responses can be cached at the CDN with plain HTTP caching (this protects the 1.2 s FCP target), and Next.js route handlers implement REST directly. GraphQL would add a schema layer and make CDN caching harder without solving a real problem for this project.

## **3.2 Conventions**

| Topic            | Rule                                                                                                                                 |
|------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Base path        | `/api`. All traffic over HTTPS (TLS 1.3).                                                                                            |
| Format           | JSON requests and responses, `Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8`. Property names in camelCase. IDs are UUID strings.    |
| Dates            | ISO 8601 in UTC, for example `2026-10-12T09:30:00Z`.                                                                                 |
| Student identity | Anonymous. `POST /api/students/session` sets the cookie `cn_student` (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax). No personal data is sent.      |
| Admin identity   | `POST /api/admin/login` sets the cookie `cn_admin` (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict). The session expires after 30 minutes of inactivity (NFR-08). |
| Access levels    | **Public** = no cookie needed. **Student** = needs `cn_student`. **Admin** = needs `cn_admin`.                                       |
| Pagination       | `?page=1&limit=12` (limit at most 50). Response: `{ "data": [...], "meta": { "page": 1, "limit": 12, "total": 40, "totalPages": 4 } }`. |
| Caching          | Public GET responses for courses, categories and modules send `Cache-Control: public, s-maxage=60, stale-while-revalidate=300`. Admin changes revalidate the cache. Student and admin responses are `no-store`. |
| Input checks     | Every body, query and path parameter is validated and sanitized on the server (NFR-07). Invalid input returns `422`.                  |
| Rate limits      | `POST /api/summarize`: 10 requests per minute per student. `POST /api/admin/login`: 5 failed attempts per 15 minutes per IP. Exceeding returns `429` with `Retry-After`. |
| Error format     | `{ "error": { "code": "VALIDATION_ERROR", "message": "Human readable text", "details": [ { "field": "title", "issue": "required" } ] } }` |

**Standard error codes**

| HTTP | Code                  | Meaning                                                                 |
|------|-----------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| 400  | `BAD_REQUEST`         | Malformed JSON or missing body                                          |
| 401  | `UNAUTHENTICATED`     | Missing or expired cookie; wrong admin credentials (`INVALID_CREDENTIALS`) |
| 403  | `FORBIDDEN`           | Valid session but not allowed (for example a student calling an admin endpoint) |
| 404  | `NOT_FOUND`           | Course, module, quiz or MCQ does not exist                              |
| 409  | `CONFLICT`            | Duplicate course code, or a quiz already exists for the module          |
| 422  | `VALIDATION_ERROR`    | A field failed validation                                               |
| 429  | `RATE_LIMITED`        | Too many requests                                                       |
| 502  | `AI_UNAVAILABLE`      | The AI service returned an error (client shows the fallback notice)     |
| 504  | `AI_TIMEOUT`          | The AI service did not answer within 2.5 s (client shows the fallback notice) |
| 500  | `INTERNAL_ERROR`      | Unexpected server error                                                 |

#### **E05  POST /api/students/session**

Request: empty body. Creates an anonymous student and sets the `cn_student` cookie. If a valid cookie already exists the same student is returned.

Response `201` (new) or `200` (existing):

```json
{ "studentId": "s123...", "createdAt": "2026-10-12T09:30:00Z" }
```

No name, e-mail or password is requested or stored (NFR-06).

#### **E06  GET /api/students/me/enrollments**

Response `200`:

```json
{ "data": [ { "courseId": "c1f0...", "code": "CS-301", "title": "Data Structures", "enrolledAt": "2026-10-12T09:35:00Z" } ] }
```

#### **E07  POST /api/students/me/enrollments**

Request: `{ "courseId": "c1f0..." }`. Repeating the call has no extra effect.

Response `201` (new) or `200` (already enrolled): `{ "courseId": "c1f0...", "enrolledAt": "2026-10-12T09:35:00Z" }`.

Errors: `404` if the course does not exist.

#### **E08  GET /api/students/me/progress**

| Query      | Type   | Required | Description                                       |
|------------|--------|----------|---------------------------------------------------|
| `courseId` | UUID   | no       | If given, the response also contains `course`     |

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "progressPct": 25.0, "completedModules": 3, "lastVisitedModuleId": "m003...",
  "course": { "courseId": "c1f0...", "totalModules": 12, "completedModules": 3,
              "completedModuleIds": ["m001...", "m002...", "m003..."] }
}
```

#### **E09  PUT /api/students/me/progress/last-visited**

Request: `{ "moduleId": "m003..." }`. Response `200`: the progress object of E08. Errors: `404` module not found.

#### **E10  PUT /api/students/me/progress/modules/{moduleId}**

Request: `{ "completed": true }`. The server adds or removes the row in `progress_modules` and recalculates `completedModules` and `progressPct` in one transaction.

Response `200`: the progress object of E08. Errors: `404` module not found, `422` if `completed` is not a boolean.

#### **E11  POST /api/summarize**

Request:

```json
{ "moduleId": "m003...", "content": "Module text sent for summarization (1 to 20,000 characters)" }
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "summary": "Markdown summary of the module.",
  "keyTakeaways": ["point 1", "point 2", "point 3", "point 4"],
  "cached": false,
  "generatedAt": "2026-10-12T09:41:00Z"
}
```

Behaviour: the server hashes the content. If a row with the same `moduleId` and hash exists in `ai_summaries` it is returned with `cached: true`. Otherwise the server calls the AI service with a 2.5 s timeout, stores the result and returns it. `keyTakeaways` always has exactly 4 items.

Errors: `422` (empty or too long content, unknown module), `429` (rate limit), `502 AI_UNAVAILABLE`, `504 AI_TIMEOUT`. For `502` and `504` the screen shows: "Summary unavailable. Please refer to module text."

#### **E12  GET /api/quizzes/{quizId}**

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "id": "q003...", "moduleId": "m003...", "subject": "Data Structures", "mcqCount": 20,
  "questions": [
    { "id": "k001...", "question": "Which data structure follows LIFO order?",
      "options": ["Queue", "Stack", "Binary tree", "Hash table"],
      "correctOption": 1,
      "explanation": "A stack removes the most recently added element first." }
  ]
}
```

The response contains only questions of this quiz (NFR-10). The correct option and the explanation are included so that the browser can colour the answer and open the explanation immediately without another request (150 ms target, NFR-02). The quiz is a self-assessment, so this does not affect marks. The order of the questions is shuffled for every call.

Errors: `404 NOT_FOUND`; `503` with message "Quiz content unavailable" if the question bank cannot be read (screen offers "Reload Quiz").

#### **E13  POST /api/quizzes/{quizId}/results**

Request:

```json
{ "answers": [ { "mcqId": "k001...", "selectedOption": 1 }, { "mcqId": "k002...", "selectedOption": 3 } ] }
```

The server ignores any score sent by the client and recalculates it from the answers: `score = correct / total x 100`.

Response `201`:

```json
{
  "resultId": "r777...", "quizId": "q003...", "score": 80.0,
  "correctCount": 16, "incorrectCount": 4, "totalCount": 20,
  "attemptDate": "2026-10-12T09:55:00Z",
  "review": [ { "mcqId": "k001...", "selectedOption": 1, "correctOption": 1, "isCorrect": true } ]
}
```

Errors: `422` if an `mcqId` does not belong to this quiz, an option is outside 0 to 3, or an answer is duplicated; `404` if the quiz does not exist.

#### **E14  GET /api/students/me/results**

| Query    | Type    | Required | Description                         |
|----------|---------|----------|-------------------------------------|
| `quizId` | UUID    | no       | Only attempts of this quiz          |
| `page`, `limit` | integer | no | Pagination (default 1 and 12)    |

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "data": [ { "resultId": "r777...", "quizId": "q003...", "score": 80.0, "correctCount": 16, "totalCount": 20, "attemptDate": "2026-10-12T09:55:00Z" } ],
  "stats": { "attempts": 3, "bestScore": 85.0, "averageScore": 78.3 },
  "meta": { "page": 1, "limit": 12, "total": 3, "totalPages": 1 }
}
```

## **3.5 Admin Endpoints**

All admin endpoints except E15 need a valid `cn_admin` cookie. Without it they return `401`. They return `403` if the account is not an administrator.

#### **E15  POST /api/admin/login**

Request: `{ "email": "admin@example.edu", "password": "********" }`

Response `200` and the `cn_admin` cookie:

```json
{ "admin": { "id": "a001...", "name": "Admin Name", "accessLevel": "EDITOR" }, "expiresAt": "2026-10-12T10:25:00Z" }
```

Errors: `401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS` (the same message for a wrong e-mail or a wrong password), `429` after 5 failed attempts in 15 minutes.

#### **E16  POST /api/admin/logout**

Response `204`. The cookie is cleared.

#### **E17  GET /api/admin/me**

Response `200`: `{ "id": "a001...", "name": "Admin Name", "accessLevel": "EDITOR", "expiresAt": "2026-10-12T10:25:00Z" }`

#### **E18  POST /api/admin/courses**

Request:

```json
{ "code": "CS-301", "title": "Data Structures", "university": "PTUT", "category": "Computer Science" }
```

Response `201`: the course object of E02 with `moduleCount: 0`. Errors: `409 CONFLICT` (duplicate `code`), `422` (missing field, `code` longer than 20, `title` longer than 200).

#### **E19  PUT /api/admin/courses/{courseId}**

Request: same fields as E18 (all required). Response `200`: the updated course. Errors: `404`, `409`, `422`.

#### **E20  DELETE /api/admin/courses/{courseId}**

Response `204`. The course and its modules, quizzes, MCQs, summaries, enrollments and progress links are deleted (`ON DELETE CASCADE`). Errors: `404`.

#### **E21  POST /api/admin/courses/{courseId}/modules**

Request: `{ "title": "Linked Lists", "content": "## Markdown text", "position": 3 }`. If `position` is omitted the module is added at the end; if it is given, later modules move down by one. `moduleCount` of the course is updated.

Response `201`: `{ "id": "m003...", "courseId": "c1f0...", "title": "Linked Lists", "position": 3 }`. Errors: `404` (course), `422` (empty title or content).

#### **E22  PUT /api/admin/modules/{moduleId}**

Request: `{ "title": "Linked Lists", "content": "## Updated Markdown" }`. Response `200`: the module. Cached AI summaries of this module become unused automatically because the content hash changes. Errors: `404`, `422`.

#### **E23  DELETE /api/admin/modules/{moduleId}**

Response `204`. Later modules of the course move up by one and `moduleCount` is updated. Errors: `404`.

#### **E24  PUT /api/admin/courses/{courseId}/modules/order**

Request: `{ "moduleIds": ["m002...", "m001...", "m003..."] }` (every module of the course exactly once). Positions are rewritten in one transaction (the unique constraint is deferred). Response `200`: `{ "data": [ { "id": "m002...", "position": 1 } ] }`. Errors: `404`, `422` (ids missing, repeated or from another course).

#### **E25  POST /api/admin/modules/{moduleId}/quiz**

Request: `{ "subject": "Data Structures", "mcqCount": 20 }` (`mcqCount` optional, default 20). Response `201`: `{ "id": "q003...", "moduleId": "m003...", "subject": "Data Structures", "mcqCount": 20 }`. Errors: `404`, `409` (the module already has a quiz), `422`.

#### **E26  GET /api/admin/quizzes/{quizId}/mcqs**

Response `200`: `{ "data": [ { "id": "k001...", "question": "...", "options": ["A","B","C","D"], "correctOption": 1, "explanation": "..." } ], "count": 20, "required": 20 }`. Errors: `404`.

#### **E27  POST /api/admin/quizzes/{quizId}/mcqs**

Request:

```json
{ "question": "Which data structure follows LIFO order?",
  "options": ["Queue", "Stack", "Binary tree", "Hash table"],
  "correctOption": 1,
  "explanation": "A stack removes the most recently added element first." }
```

Response `201`: the MCQ with its `id`. Errors: `404` (quiz), `422` (not exactly 4 non-empty options, `correctOption` outside 0 to 3, empty question or explanation).

#### **E28  PUT /api/admin/mcqs/{mcqId}**

Request: same as E27. Response `200`: the updated MCQ. The MCQ cannot be moved to another quiz. Errors: `404`, `422`.

#### **E29  DELETE /api/admin/mcqs/{mcqId}**

Response `204`. Errors: `404`.

#### **E30  GET /api/health**

Response `200`: `{ "status": "ok", "database": "up", "time": "2026-10-12T09:30:00Z" }`. Response `503` with `"database": "down"` if the database cannot be reached. Used by the uptime monitor (NFR-09).

---

# **4. UI Wireframes**

The wireframes are low-fidelity, grey-scale layouts for desktop width (1200 px). Red numbered circles point to the elements described in the tables. Colour is used only where it carries meaning (green and red answers, error notices). Each wireframe is also supplied as its own draw.io file.

**Screen flow.** Home (1) leads to the Module Reader (2). From the reader the student opens the AI Summarizer Drawer (3) or starts the Quiz (4). After the last question the Score Report (5) is shown, with a link back to the course. The administrator signs in at `/admin` and works in the MCQ Management screen (6).

**Responsive behaviour (320 px to 2560 px, NFR-12).** The course grid shows 3 columns on desktop, 2 on tablet and 1 on mobile. On tablet and mobile the module index in the Reader becomes a collapsible menu, and the AI drawer opens as a bottom sheet. Quiz options stay full width on every screen. The admin screen is designed for desktop and tablet.

---

# **6. Conclusion**

The database is a 12-table PostgreSQL schema that keeps every entity and relationship of the project ERD, protects quiz isolation and the 4-option and 4-takeaway rules with constraints, and defines 19 indexes (some of them created by unique constraints), each tied to a real query. The 30 REST endpoints cover every use case from UC-01 to UC-12 with request, response and error contracts. The six wireframes show every primary screen and point to the endpoints that feed them. Together they give a clear plan for the build phase. The editable draw.io source of the ERD and of each wireframe is supplied as separate files.
